source.publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

lines.en: 1. Whose turn is it to take the minutes?
(A) It will take about fifteen minutes.
(B) I'll do it.
(C) Marcus did it.
2. How can we meet the project deadline?
lines.zh: 2. 我們要怎麼趕上專案的截止期限？

lines.en: (A) We've got to have the staff work overtime.
(B) Are we leaving the projector on?
(C) The meeting went too long.
3. Has the virus been removed from my laptop?
lines.zh: 3. 我筆電裡的病毒清掉了嗎？

lines.en: (A) Yes, but some data are also lost.
lines.zh: (A) 清掉了，但也有些資料不見了。

lines.en: (B) Yes, it's been moved to the corner.
(C) Not yet, the city hall hasn't approved it.
4. Lily just contacted a real estate agent about our new retail space.
lines.zh: 4. Lily 剛聯絡了房仲，詢問我們新店面的事。

lines.en: (A) She is always so efficient in her work.
(B) No, they were contact lenses.
(C) What do you think of the retail prices?
5. Don't you think the last passage can be further improved?
lines.zh: 5. 你不覺得最後一段還可以再改進嗎？

lines.en: (A) No, the passengers didn't complain.
(B) Sure, the cover can be removed.
(C) Yes, Michelle and I will proofread it again later.
lines.zh: (C) 是的，Michelle 和我晚點會再校對一次。

lines.en: 6. Where can we display these new product samples?
lines.zh: 6. 這些新產品樣品可以放在哪裡展示？

lines.en: (A) In the glass case by the register.
(B) They're still working on a screenplay.
(C) From a new supplier.
7. You have no more appointments scheduled for this afternoon, do you?
lines.zh: 7. 你今天下午沒有其他約了，對吧？

lines.en: (A) No, I'm free after 2:30.
lines.zh: (A) 沒有，我兩點半以後有空。

lines.en: (B) Yes, it's quite disappointing.
(C) Yes, it is.
8. Could you share your findings at the sales training meeting on Friday?
lines.zh: 8. 你可以在週五的業務訓練會議上分享你的研究結果嗎？

lines.en: (A) Not everyone was present.
(B) A fine for unpaid tax.
(C) That's the purpose of my research.
lines.zh: (C) 這正是我做研究的目的。

lines.en: 9. Why do you show up to work so early in the morning?
lines.zh: 9. 你為什麼一大早就來上班？

lines.en: (A) To avoid the rush hour traffic.
lines.zh: (A) 為了避開尖峰時段的車潮。

lines.en: (B) Due to the shower this morning.
lines.zh: (B) 因為今天早上下了陣雨。

lines.en: (C) I got caught in the traffic.
10. Can you help look over these résumés this afternoon?
lines.zh: 10. 你今天下午可以幫忙看這些履歷嗎？

lines.en: (A) Sure, here's my application.
(B) I prefer a room overlooking the lake.
(C) Sorry, but I'm tied up all day.
11. Where will the president make her annual speech?
lines.zh: 11. 董事長的年度演講會在哪裡舉行？

lines.en: (A) We were upgraded to a presidential suite.
lines.zh: (A) 我們被升等到總統套房。

lines.en: (B) It was so boring and also tedious.
(C) On the third floor by the lounge.
12. What kind of cake should we buy for Kimberly's retirement party?
lines.zh: 12. Kimberly 的退休派對我們該買哪種蛋糕？

lines.en: (A) She doesn't like anything sour.
(B) Every other week.
(C) We had a great time.
13. How much sales growth do they project?
lines.zh: 13. 他們預估銷售成長多少？

lines.en: (A) 120 each.
(B) They're expecting at least five percent over last year.
lines.zh: (B) 他們預期比去年至少成長百分之五。

lines.en: (C) About 20 projectors, I think.
lines.zh: (C) 我想大約二十台投影機。

lines.en: 14. Will your art museum still be open this evening?
lines.zh: 14. 你們美術館今晚還開放嗎？

lines.en: (A) Yes, our main gallery will reopen next week.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，我們的主展廳下週重新開放。

lines.en: (B) A free map is available at the counter.
(C) I'm afraid there's a private event at six.
15. Were you able to get through to her, or should I try calling?
lines.zh: 15. 你聯絡上她了嗎？還是要我打打看？

lines.en: (A) We didn't pull through the recession.
(B) It always went to voicemail when I called.
lines.zh: (B) 我打的時候都轉到語音信箱。

lines.en: (C) Let me put you through to her.
16. Our company is going to open a branch in Bangkok next year.
lines.zh: 16. 我們公司明年要在曼谷開分公司。

lines.en: (A) We'll need to transfer some staff.
lines.zh: (A) 我們得調派一些員工過去。

lines.en: (B) What brand do you recommend?
(C) There's an overseas call for you.
17. What should we do about the defective films we received?
lines.zh: 17. 我們收到的瑕疵底片該怎麼處理？

lines.en: (A) Do we still have the receipt?
(B) Offer them a refund.
(C) Send them replacements.
18. Don't forget to get some euros before our trip to Germany.
lines.zh: 18. 去德國之前別忘了換些歐元。

lines.en: (A) Sure, I prefer a window seat.
(B) I already have a visa.
(C) Thanks for the reminder.
19. Have you received the survey data from the agency, or should I ask them to hurry up?
lines.zh: 19. 你收到調查公司的資料了嗎？還是要我催他們？

lines.en: (A) Yes, they are very firm in their demands.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，他們的要求很堅定。

lines.en: (B) Let me check my email.
(C) Yes, based on the data they provided.
lines.zh: (C) 是的，根據他們提供的資料。

lines.en: 20. How much did you spend purchasing office supplies last quarter?
lines.zh: 20. 你上一季買辦公用品花了多少錢？

lines.en: (A) Why don't you ask Mr. Nelson in Accounting?
lines.zh: (A) 你何不問問會計部的 Nelson 先生？

lines.en: (B) We ran out of copy paper.
(C) Because we didn't meet the monthly quota.
lines.zh: (C) 因為我們沒達到每月配額。
